description: 公共施設 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 目黒区. 目黒区内の公共施設の一覧 ・区役所 ・地区サービス事務所 ・行政サービス窓口 ・包括支援センター ・斎場 ・住区センター ・社会教育館 ・文化会館 ・図書館 ・ホール ・スポーツ施設 ・福祉施設 ・老人いこいの家 ・養護老人ホーム ・在宅ケア ・保育園 ・児童館 ・学童保育クラブ ・こども園 ・子育て総合相談窓口 ・小学校 ・中学校 ・学... Coverage: 目黒区. The portal files it under the publisher 目黒区. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
